props.doc:
Run one AI action and return a validated structured result.

Order matters and is the point: the tool set was computed at session start,
evidence is wrapped and screened here, the response is schema-validated, and
everything is audited with the session, the model and the provider.
props.name: run_action

props.code:
from soar.ai.gateway import make_provider, resolve_route
from soar.ai.safety import screen_for_injection, system_framing, turn_budget, wrap_evidence
from soar.audit.log import record as audit_record
from soar.commands.registry import validate_io
from soar.platform.ids import new_id

import json

schemas = action_schemas()
if action not in schemas:
    raise KeyError("unknown AI action %r" % action)

route = resolve_route(db, session["org_id"], inputs.get("role", "fast"),
                      contains_incident_data=True)
provider = make_provider(route, None)

evidence_blocks, injection_flags = [], []
for field, value in sorted(inputs.items()):
    if field in ("role", "subject"):
        continue
    text = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, default=str)
    injection_flags.extend(screen_for_injection(text))
    evidence_blocks.append(
        wrap_evidence(inputs.get("subject", "incident"),
                      session.get("incident_id", "-"), field, text)
    )

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": system_framing(session.get("purpose", "general"))},
    {"role": "system",
     "content": "Reply with JSON matching this schema and nothing else:\n"
                + json.dumps(schemas[action])},
    {"role": "user", "content": "\n\n".join(evidence_blocks)},
]

budget = turn_budget(session.get("purpose", "general"))
response = provider.complete(messages, [], {
    "max_tokens": budget["max_tokens"],
    "temperature": 0.1,
    "timeout_s": budget["max_wall_clock_s"],
})

try:
    structured = json.loads(response["text"])
except ValueError:
    raise ValueError("the model did not return JSON; the step fails rather than guessing")
validate_io(schemas[action], structured, "ai output")

turn_id = new_id("turn")
db.execute(
    "INSERT INTO ai_turn (id, session_id, sequence, role, model, provider_id, "
    "tokens_in, tokens_out, finish_reason, injection_flags) "
    "SELECT %s, %s, coalesce(max(sequence), 0) + 1, 'assistant', %s, %s, %s, %s, "
    "%s, %s FROM ai_turn WHERE session_id = %s",
    [turn_id, session["id"], response["model"], route["id"],
     response["tokens_in"], response["tokens_out"], response["finish_reason"],
     json.dumps(injection_flags), session["id"]],
    session["org_id"],
)

audit_record(db, {
    "org_id": session["org_id"], "actor_kind": "ai",
    "actor_id": session["id"], "on_behalf_of_id": session.get("user_id"),
    "action": "ai.action." + action, "target_kind": "incident",
    "target_id": session.get("incident_id"), "ai_session_id": session["id"],
    "after": {"model": response["model"], "provider": route["kind"],
              "injection_flags": len(injection_flags)},
    "result": "success",
})

return {"action": action, "structured": structured, "turn_id": turn_id,
        "model": response["model"], "provider": route["kind"],
        "injection_flags": injection_flags,
        "accepted": False}

props.doc:
Draft a playbook from a natural-language objective.

The result is always a draft. There is no code path from here to published:
the version state machine does not contain the transition, and the catalogue
of real commands is supplied as part of the request so the model cannot name
a command that does not exist.
props.name: generate_playbook_draft

props.code:
from soar.ai.gateway import make_provider, resolve_route
from soar.ai.safety import system_framing, wrap_evidence
from soar.audit.log import record as audit_record
from soar.platform.ids import new_id
from soar.playbooks.validate import validate_playbook

import hashlib
import json

catalogue = db.query(
    "SELECT c.key, c.name, cv.input_schema, cv.output_schema, cv.risk_level, "
    "cv.effect FROM command c JOIN command_version cv ON cv.id = c.current_version_id "
    "WHERE (c.org_id = %s OR c.org_id IS NULL) AND NOT c.deprecated "
    "AND cv.state = 'published'", [session["org_id"]], session["org_id"],
)

route = resolve_route(db, session["org_id"], "reasoning",
                      contains_incident_data=False)
provider = make_provider(route, None)

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": system_framing("playbook drafting")},
    {"role": "system",
     "content": "Use only these commands. Naming one that is not listed is an "
                "error, not a suggestion:\n" + json.dumps(catalogue, default=str)},
    {"role": "user", "content": wrap_evidence("objective", "-", "text", objective)},
]
response = provider.complete(messages, [], {"max_tokens": 8192, "temperature": 0.2})

definition = json.loads(response["text"])

# The same validator every human-authored playbook faces. A draft that does
# not validate is still stored, so the reviewer can see what was proposed and
# why it was refused.
problems = validate_playbook(definition)
known = {row["key"] for row in catalogue}
for node_id, node in (definition.get("nodes") or {}).items():
    if node.get("kind") == "command" and node.get("command") not in known:
        problems.append("%s names %r, which is not a real command"
                        % (node_id, node.get("command")))

canonical = json.dumps(definition, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
version_id = new_id("pbv")
db.execute(
    "INSERT INTO playbook_version (id, playbook_id, version, state, definition, "
    "content_sha256, created_by, notes) "
    "VALUES (%s, %s, 1, 'draft', %s, %s, %s, %s)",
    [version_id, session["playbook_id"], json.dumps(definition),
     hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).digest(),
     "ai:" + session["id"],
     "AI draft. Validation: " + ("; ".join(problems) if problems else "clean")],
    session["org_id"],
)
audit_record(db, {
    "org_id": session["org_id"], "actor_kind": "ai", "actor_id": session["id"],
    "on_behalf_of_id": session.get("user_id"),
    "action": "playbook.draft.generated", "target_kind": "playbook_version",
    "target_id": version_id, "ai_session_id": session["id"],
    "after": {"validation_problems": len(problems)}, "result": "success",
})
return version_id

props.doc:
A human accepts an AI conclusion.

Until this runs, the conclusion is a proposal. Storing acceptance as a fact
rather than a UI state is what makes "did a person agree with this" an
answerable question a year later.
props.name: accept_analysis

from soar.audit.log import record as audit_record
from soar.identity.rbac import require_permission

require_permission(principal, "incidents.write")
db.execute(
    "UPDATE ai_analysis SET accepted_by = %s, accepted_at = now() "
    "WHERE id = %s AND org_id = %s AND accepted_by IS NULL",
    [principal["id"], analysis_id, principal["org_id"]],
    principal["org_id"],
)
audit_record(db, {
    "org_id": principal["org_id"], "actor_kind": "user",
    "actor_id": principal["id"], "action": "ai.analysis.accepted",
    "target_kind": "ai_analysis", "target_id": analysis_id, "result": "success",
})
